# Sincerely Cozy

> Sincerely Cozy sells luxury bamboo baby swaddle blankets, sold through its Amazon store. Each swaddle measures 34" × 40" and is made from 95% bamboo rayon.

Customer service: customerservice@sincerelycozy.com, +1 913-378-7608 (913-378-7608).

## Products
- [All swaddles](https://sincerelycozy.com/products): the six bamboo swaddle prints
- [Baby Blue](https://sincerelycozy.com/products/baby-blue): light-blue plaid on white
- [Cozy Teddy Bear](https://sincerelycozy.com/products/cozy-teddy-bear): illustrated teddy bears on cream
- [Dreamy Clouds](https://sincerelycozy.com/products/dreamy-clouds): aqua and grey clouds and stars on white
- [Little Butterfly](https://sincerelycozy.com/products/little-butterfly): watercolor butterflies in pink and aqua
- [Pickaboo Bear](https://sincerelycozy.com/products/pickaboo-bear): peeking white bear faces on soft pink
- [Rose Petal](https://sincerelycozy.com/products/rose-petal): watercolor rose petals in blush pink

## Customer help
- [FAQ](https://sincerelycozy.com/faq): fabric, size, what ships with each print, washing, when to stop swaddling, shipping and returns
- [Care instructions](https://sincerelycozy.com/care-instructions): cold, gentle cycle, mild detergent, low heat or air dry
